data: What is the approximate maximum value of the blue dashed line in the graph labeled "Performance on PKU"?

The question asks for the approximate maximum value of the blue dashed line in the graph labeled "Performance on PKU". The blue dashed line represents the F1_Softmax metric. From the graph, we can see that the blue dashed line reaches its peak at approximately 80%. Therefore, the approximate maximum value of the blue dashed line is 80%.
